---
title: "AIRGUARD 360: Interactive Air Quality Intelligence Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: scroll
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(flexdashboard)
  library(plotly)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(DT)
  library(scales)
  library(DBI)
  library(RSQLite)
})

# Load core modules and configuration
source("R/00_config.R")
source("R/07_visualizations.R")
source("R/08_decision_support.R")

# Load preprocessed datasets and summary tables
df_city_enriched <- if (file.exists("data/processed/airguard_enriched.rds")) {
  readRDS("data/processed/airguard_enriched.rds")
} else {
  NULL
}

stats_summary <- if (file.exists("outputs/tables/pollutant_summary_stats.csv")) {
  read.csv("outputs/tables/pollutant_summary_stats.csv")
} else {
  NULL
}

cor_mat_df <- if (file.exists("outputs/tables/correlation_matrix.csv")) {
  read.csv("outputs/tables/correlation_matrix.csv", row.names = 1)
} else {
  NULL
}

hotspots_df <- if (file.exists("outputs/tables/hotspot_vulnerability_ranking.csv")) {
  read.csv("outputs/tables/hotspot_vulnerability_ranking.csv")
} else {
  NULL
}

station_geo <- if (file.exists("outputs/tables/station_geo_summary.csv")) {
  read.csv("outputs/tables/station_geo_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  NULL
}

fc_delhi <- if (file.exists("outputs/tables/forecast_delhi_pm25.rds")) {
  readRDS("outputs/tables/forecast_delhi_pm25.rds")
} else {
  NULL
}

word_freqs <- if (file.exists("outputs/tables/advisory_word_frequencies.csv")) {
  read.csv("outputs/tables/advisory_word_frequencies.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  NULL
}
```

### Statutory Criteria Pollutants Summary vs National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS)
```{r}
if (!is.null(stats_summary)) {
  DT::datatable(
    stats_summary,
    options = list(pageLength = 6, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = "Empirical Summary Moments Computed Across All 29,531 Daily Observations in India"
  )
}
```

### Key Analytical Findings at a Glance
```{r}
findings_box <- data.frame(
  Dimension = c(
    "1. Particulate Burden",
    "2. Seasonal Thermal Inversion",
    "3. Geographic Disparities",
    "4. Stoichiometric Collinearity",
    "5. Predictive Accuracy"
  ),
  Finding = c(
    "39.2% of all monitored days breach 24-hr PM2.5 limits; 47.3% breach PM10 limits nationally.",
    "Winter PM2.5 in Delhi (182.3 µg/m³) is 2.5x higher than summer (71.1 µg/m³), p < 0.0001 (Welch t = 33.51).",
    "ANOVA confirms massive variance between Indo-Gangetic basin hubs and coastal metros (F = 1327.05, p < 0.0001).",
    "Strong collinearity between PM2.5 and PM10 (r = 0.845) confirms co-emission and shared combustion origins.",
    "Native ARIMA(1,1,1) model achieved holdout Test RMSE of 11.37 µg/m³ and MAE of 9.74 µg/m³ on Delhi PM2.5."
  )
)
DT::datatable(
  findings_box,
  options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

### National Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Network (230 CAAQMS Stations)

### Top 10 High-Risk Pollution Hotspots Ranked by Historical Mean AQI
```{r}
if (!is.null(df_city_enriched)) {
  plot_city_rankings(df_city_enriched, target_var = "AQI", top_n = 10, interactive = TRUE)
} else {
  plot_empty_message("City data not available.")
}
```

Row {data-height=400}
-------------------------------------

### Environmental Vulnerability Index (EVI) Multi-Criteria Municipal Prioritization Ranking
```{r}
if (!is.null(hotspots_df)) {
  display_evi <- hotspots_df %>%
    select(Rank, City, State, Mean_AQI, Pct_Severe_Days, PM2.5_Exceed_Rate, EVI_Score, Priority_Tier)
  
  DT::datatable(
    display_evi,
    options = list(pageLength = 8, dom = "ftp", scrollX = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = "Composite Multi-Criteria Environmental Vulnerability Index (EVI) Table across 26 Monitored Cities"
  ) %>%
    formatRound(columns = c("Mean_AQI", "Pct_Severe_Days", "PM2.5_Exceed_Rate", "EVI_Score"), digits = 1) %>%
    formatStyle(
      "Priority_Tier",
      backgroundColor = styleEqual(
        c("Tier 1: Critical", "Tier 2: High", "Tier 3: Moderate"),
        c("#FEE2E2", "#FEF3C7", "#DCFCE7")
      ),
      color = styleEqual(
        c("Tier 1: Critical", "Tier 2: High", "Tier 3: Moderate"),
        c("#991B1B", "#92400E", "#166534")
      ),
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
}
```

Statistical Models & Forecasts
=====================================

Row {data-height=260}
-------------------------------------

### Formal Parametric & Non-Parametric Hypothesis Testing Summary
```{r}
hypo_summary <- data.frame(
  Test = c(
    "1. Welch Two-Sample t-Test",
    "2. One-Way ANOVA",
    "3. Pearson Correlation Test",
    "4. Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test"
  ),
  Hypothesis_Investigated = c(
    "Winter vs Summer/Monsoon PM2.5 in Delhi",
    "AQI variance across 5 major Indian metropolitan clusters",
    "Stoichiometric linearity between PM2.5 and PM10",
    "Empirical AQI distribution normality diagnostic"
  ),
  Test_Statistic = c("t = 33.51 (df = 623.5)", "F = 1,327.05 (df = 4, 7317)", "r = 0.845 (t = 188.4, df = 14832)", "D = 0.1432 (N = 1000)"),
  P_Value = c("< 2.2e-16 (p < 0.0001)", "< 2.2e-16 (p < 0.0001)", "< 2.2e-16 (p < 0.0001)", "< 2.2e-16 (p < 0.0001)"),
  Formal_Decision = c(
    "Reject H0: Winter PM2.5 (182.3 µg/m³) is significantly higher than summer (71.1 µg/m³).",
    "Reject H0: Extreme regional disparity; Indo-Gangetic basin metros far more polluted.",
    "Reject H0: Highly significant positive correlation; shared emission origins.",
    "Reject H0: Ambient air distributions exhibit heavy positive skewness."
  )
)
DT::datatable(
  hypo_summary,
  options = list(pageLength = 4, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

### Native Time-Series Predictive Forecasting (30-Day ARIMA Projection with 80% & 95% Confidence Bounds)
```{r}

  plot_forecast_chart(fc_delhi, interactive = TRUE)
} else {
  plot_empty_message("Predictive forecast object not available.")
}
```

### Out-of-Sample Predictive Model Performance Comparison (Delhi PM2.5)
```{r}
model_comp <- data.frame(
  Model_Architecture = c("ARIMA (1,1,1) [Selected]", "Holt-Winters Exponential Smoothing"),
  Out_of_Sample_RMSE = c("11.37 µg/m³", "14.82 µg/m³"),
  Out_of_Sample_MAE = c("9.74 µg/m³", "12.15 µg/m³"),
  MAPE_Percentage = c("22.1%", "28.4%"),
  Forecasting_Horizon = c("30 Calendar Days", "30 Calendar Days"),
  Model_Verdict = c("Superior generalization; captures autoregressive autocorrelation", "Baseline smoothing; slightly wider residual error variance")
)
DT::datatable(
  model_comp,
  options = list(pageLength = 2, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

### Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) Statutory Municipal Advisory Directives
```{r}
grap_table <- data.frame(
  AQI_Range = c("0 – 50", "51 – 100", "101 – 200", "201 – 300", "301 – 400", "> 400"),
  GRAP_Stage = c("Stage 0: Baseline", "Stage 0: Baseline", "Stage 1: Moderate", "Stage 2: Very Poor", "Stage 3: Severe", "Stage 4: Severe+"),
  Alert_Color = c("Green (#00B050)", "Light Green (#92D050)", "Yellow (#FFFF00)", "Orange (#FF9900)", "Red (#FF0000)", "Purple (#7030A0)"),
  Statutory_Municipal_Action = c(
    "Routine baseline monitoring; maintain green parks and active street cleaning.",
    "Maintain standard dust suppression; monitor industrial smokestack emissions.",
    "Deploy mechanized road sweepers; enforce anti-dust rules at construction sites.",
    "Ban diesel generator sets; increase parking fees 3–4x to discourage private vehicles; boost metro frequency.",
    "Halt all non-essential construction and demolition; close brick kilns and stone crushers; vacuum clean roads.",
    "Ban diesel commercial trucks from entering city; halt physical primary schooling; mandate 50% work-from-home."
  )
)
DT::datatable(
  grap_table,
  options = list(pageLength = 6, dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Official Statutory Emergency Mitigation Framework"
)
```

    "Indexed Query Latency"

  Implementation_Specification = c(
    "SQLite 3 Embedded Engine via DBI and RSQLite R Packages",
    "data/airguard.sqlite (Normalized Relational Star Schema)",
    "fact_station_day (108,035 rows, multi-pollutant measurements per station-day)",
    "fact_city_day (29,531 rows, official municipal daily aggregates)",
